usageNotes: Permanently removes an SDN DNS integration object from the cluster configuration. Requires the SDN.Allocate privilege on /sdn/dns and must be called before the deletion is propagated — run apply_cluster_sdn (POST /cluster/sdn) afterward to push the change to all nodes. If the SDN config is currently locked, obtain the lock token first and pass it via lock-token.

examples.summary: Delete the SDN DNS object named 'powerdns1'

destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the SDN DNS object and its configuration; any VNets or subnets relying on this DNS provider will lose DNS integration until a replacement object is created and applied.
tips: The dns identifier must match the pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*[a-zA-Z0-9] (alphanumeric, starts with a letter, minimum 2 chars).
Deletion only removes the pending config record; you must call POST /cluster/sdn to apply and propagate the change cluster-wide.
If the SDN layer is locked by another operation, the request will fail unless you supply the correct lock-token.
